description: Run an operator-supplied maintenance pipeline through a shell.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary maintenance pipeline dispatch software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs maintenance pipeline dispatch only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. External processes are started without adequate input or resource controls. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
